reason: I always get three local quotes and go with the middle one. At £655 from someone in Kuwait with no UK reviews, he'd be the cheapest quote by a mile, and I never go with the cheapest. Pay-when-happy is nice but it doesn't make me trust him.
objection: He's not local, there are no UK clients or reviews, and the price is low enough that I wonder what I'm really getting and who sorts it out when something breaks after the first few months.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three real UK clients, ideally in Manchester, that I could message or look at their live sites, plus a quote that sits closer to what local firms charge so I'm comparing like for like.
